name: National Museum of India
scope: The standing National Museum of India on Janpath, including the north polygonal block, circular sculpture courtyard, adjoining old Archaeological Survey of India wing, exterior cladding and the mapped entrance.
era: The 1960 Janpath National Museum with its completed 1989 phase

originalReview.notes: The exact already-published Daderot original is self-dedicated to the public domain. Its view records the open circular court, two levels of large dark windows divided by cream engaged columns, small upper openings and grilles, pink sandstone floor, paved paths and decorative fountain. The gallery-object pictures and attribution-licensed exterior views are excluded.
